label: MDC: I would like to continue my degree here
source: MDC Associate in Arts Degree Pathway Guide, effective Fall 2026
notes: The student plans to continue their degree at MDC instead of transferring, so there is no separate transfer-school audit. Use the AA audit.
No program-specific requirements for other MDC degrees or programs are loaded in this tool. After the AA plan, recommend meeting an MDC advisor about program-specific requirements.
Pathway electives (24 credits) should be chosen with the student's intended program in mind. Confirm choices with an MDC advisor.
